newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts eye 115-08 on way to 115-16.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts eye 115-08 on way to 115-16.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE will on Tuesday aim to recapture two peaks on the charts, invigorated by Monday's bullish performance, technical analysts said.
But beyond 115-16 momentum would begin to tire.
"There is some bullish sentiment within intra-day markets," Mike Macdonald, technical analyst at 4CAST in London said.
Macdonald said the contract would first push for the August 8 high of 115-08 and then set its sights on the August 7 spike of 115-19.
At 0705 GMT, September gilt futures were at 114-29, down 5/32 on the day.
"If it moves towards there we're going to see intra-day momentum overbought," Macdonald said. "It doesn't look like it has the power to keep going."
Beyond the 115-16 area, the contract would run into congestion in the 115-25 to 116-02 zone, the range top and contract high, he said.
Support this session would surface first at the 114-25/23 area, from intra-day highs and lows, Macdonald said. "Beneath here I've got 114-17, a buying level, after August 15."
Trendline support then comes in at around 114-10 from a line connecting the May 28, June 24 and August 8 lows.
Analysts at Chase in London said holding above the 114-31 former range top and initial support at 114-26 was needed to maintain the improved near term technical outlook.

"However, failure to maintain the move above 114-31/114-26 will return the gilt to the former trading range, targetting major trendline support currently intervening at 114-08 on daily charts," they said in a research note.
A break here would put the 114-03 low on August 11 into play, they added.
December short sterling futures were quoted at 92.63, unchanged on the day.
